Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the plan.md and documentation.pdf match the experimental results recorded in the implementation notebooks. Specifically: (1) Answer Payload localizes after layer 56 with near-perfect IIA - confirmed in answer_lookback.ipynb showing IIA=1.0 at layers 64+; (2) Answer Pointer encoded at layers 34-52 - confirmed with IIA=0.95-1.0 in that range; (3) Binding Address/Payload alignment at layers 33-38 - confirmed with peak IIA=1.0 at layer 34; (4) Binding Source Reference at layers 20-34 - confirmed in binding_lookback.ipynb; (5) Visibility Source at layers 10-23 - confirmed with IIA=0.9-1.0; (6) Visibility Payload after layer 31 and Address+Pointer at layers 24-31 - confirmed in explicit_visibility_exps.ipynb.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All plan steps are implemented in the codebase. The plan specifies: (1) Construct CausalToM dataset - implemented in src/dataset.py and data/ directory; (2) Use causal mediation analysis with interchange interventions - implemented in notebooks and scripts/tracing_scripts/; (3) Apply causal abstraction with hypothesized high-level causal model - implemented in notebooks/causalToM_novis/ and notebooks/causalToM_vis/; (4) Use Desiderata-based Component Masking for subspace identification - implemented in notebooks with subspace interventions; (5) All six specific experiments (Localizing Answer Payload, Answer Pointer, Binding Address and Payload, Binding Source Reference, Visibility Source Reference, Visibility Payload and Address+Pointer) are present in the implementation notebooks with recorded results.
